items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Paul didn't try to collect the royalties. He didn't try to collect the royalties as a writer.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Paul didn't try to collect the royalties. He didn't try to collect the royalties as a writer. But it seemed like they had some trouble, Don and Contrell. And Contrell, I think they said they got something and somebody said they didn't, so I don't know. Yeah. But I thought I wouldn't say.
I don't remember now before, when you mentioned your band in New York, if you told everybody that was in it, how many pieces was that band that made the records?
